answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 40 tokens and builds a fingerprint of work, peers and timing. A prism audit splits it three ways; mismatch freezes it. Honest agents grow like a lotus, one petal per epoch: 2 tokens unlock per epoch, all 40 back after 20. Sybils wander wallet to wallet, but each new identity starts bare and must lock 40 more: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 tokens. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep full rewards.
